# Drishti IAS

> Drishti IAS is a premier online platform for UPSC Civil Services and State PCS exam preparation, offering comprehensive study materials, test series, and coaching resources.

Drishti IAS provides integrated exam preparation solutions including live NCERT courses, mock tests, previous year papers, subject-wise analysis, and strategic preparation guides for aspirants targeting Union and State civil services examinations across India.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Civil Services Examination
- UPSC Prelims & Mains
- CSAT (Aptitude Test)
- State PCS Exams
- GS Paper 1, 2, 3
- Previous Year Papers
- Mock Test Series
- NCERT Course
- Exam Strategy & Preparation
- Answer Keys & Analysis
- Civil Services Study Material
- Online Learning Portal
- Exam Notifications
- Mind Maps & Notes
- Test Series Solutions

## UPSC Exam Preparation

- [UPSC Civil Services Exam, Eligibility and Syllabus](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims/about-civil-services): UPSC Civil Services exam guide covering eligibility, syllabus & exam phases
- [UPSC Prelims Syllabus 2025](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims/preliminary-examination-syllabus): UPSC Prelims syllabus covering GS Paper 1 & CSAT with detailed topics
- [UPSC Prelims Strategy 2025](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims/gs-prelims-strategy): Comprehensive UPSC Prelims preparation strategy & study guide for aspirants
- [UPSC CSAT Preparation Strategy](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims/csat-prelims-strategy): CSAT preparation strategy with section-wise tips for UPSC Prelims exam
- [UPSC Prelims Test Series 2026](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims-test-series): UPSC Prelims Test Series 2026 with mock tests, solutions & strategy

## Study Materials & Resources

- [NCERT Course for UPSC Exam Preparation](https://www.drishtiias.com/ncert-course): NCERT online course with 150+ live classes for UPSC foundation building
- [GS Paper 1 Mind Maps](https://www.drishtiias.com/mind-map/gs-paper1): Mind maps for GS Paper 1 covering history, geography & demographics
- [GS Paper 2 Mind Maps](https://www.drishtiias.com/mind-map/gs-paper2): Mind maps for GS Paper 2 covering politics, relations & legislation
- [GS Paper 3 Mind Maps](https://www.drishtiias.com/mind-map/gs-paper3): Mind maps for GS Paper 3 covering economics, environment & technology

## Previous Year Papers & Analysis

- [Year Wise Compilation of GS Paper](https://www.drishtiias.com/free-downloads/prelims-previous-year-papers-1-gs-yearwise-downloads): Year-wise compilation of UPSC Prelims GS Paper previous year papers
- [Subject-wise UPSC Prelims Analysis](https://www.drishtiias.com/prelims/prelims-subject-wise-compilation-gs-paper-1): Subject-wise UPSC Prelims analysis with answers for GS Paper 1
- [CSAT Previous Year Papers](https://www.drishtiias.com/free-downloads/prelims-previous-year-papers-2-csat-downloads): UPSC CSAT previous year papers and answer keys for Prelims exam

## State PCS Preparation

- [State PCS Exam Preparation](https://www.drishtiias.com/state-pcs): State PCS exam preparation guide covering provincial civil services exams

## Practice & Assessment

- [Quiz & Mock Tests](https://www.drishtiias.com/quiz): Mock tests and quiz platform for UPSC & State PCS exam preparation
